services.name: Peanut Island Sandbar & Swim Tour-3Hr
services.desc: See Peanut Island! Duration 3 Hours About Relax and play on our 3-hour Peanut Island Sandbar Cruise, one of the most popular boat tours in Palm Beach. We cruise the Intracoastal Waterway to the famous Peanut Island sandbar, where we anchor in calm, shallow water perfect for swimming, floating, and soaking up the Florida sunshine. Once anchored, hop off into the crystal-clear water, kick back on provided floats, and enjoy hanging out at the sandbar with friends and family. This cruise is BYOB, and we provide water and soda on board for your convenience. It’s the ultimate blend of sightseeing, swimming, and laid-back island vibes—perfect for groups, families, and anyone looking to experience

Kick off your shoes, sip your favorite drink, and let the gentle breeze carry you along the stunning coastline. As the sun dips below the horizon, the sky transforms into a breathtaking display of colors, creating the perfect peaceful end to your day in paradise.
